1084-4279-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6794.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6794.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

997-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-5254-7741.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

147-3085-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-6797.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

277-2557-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1636-5627-7705.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-7705.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Minion creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

940-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
940-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

757-1606-3094.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

423-907-1437-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-907-1437-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-907-1437-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

252-1575-2099-5776.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1253-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4488-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-4488-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

3062-7009-7012.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-7009-7012.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

821-2403-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2265-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Hardened Scales.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

573-4572-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-4572-5702-6664.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

4484-4871-5643-6747-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5643-6747-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4484-4871-5643-6747-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5643-6747-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

725-5115-6702.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1365-2608-2921-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2608-2921-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5477-6633.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

90-228-4871-6291.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
90-228-4871-6291.description:
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Skullclamp and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

729-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
729-5917.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1308-2757-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

2105-2923-5231.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield and giving it haste.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant, adding {R}.
Repeat each combat phase.

486-1543-3364-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Arlinn has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
486-1543-3364-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Arlinn to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Arlinn.
Activate Arlinn by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1339-2425-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1409-2661-3499.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gwenna.
1409-2661-3499.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Activate Gwenna by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gwenna enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbound ability triggers, repairing it and Gwenna.
Repeat.

2367-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
